students.learningGoals: Master complex fraction arithmetic, strengthen multi-step word problem synthesis, and refine reading inference skills.

sessions.subject: Mathematics
sessions.topic: Multiplying & Dividing Fractions with Real-World Word Problems
sessions.tutorNotes: Outstanding breakthrough session! Lucas solved all 7 multi-step word problems completely without coaching. He even caught an edge case in problem #4 on his own.
sessions.nextSteps: Begin mixed numbers and decimal conversion next Tuesday.

sessions.subject: Science & Discovery
sessions.topic: Ecosystem Energy Pyramids & Food Web Dynamics
sessions.tutorNotes: Lucas showed remarkable engagement during our food web flow simulation. He grasped trophic levels and trophic cascade effects very fast.
sessions.nextSteps: Prepare short 3-minute oral explanation of keystone species.

sessions.subject: Reading Comprehension
sessions.topic: Inference & Character Motive Analysis in Fiction
sessions.tutorNotes: Solid textual evidence citing. Lucas identified subtle character motivations in chapter 4. We practiced pacing while reading aloud.
sessions.nextSteps: Focus on identifying thematic symbolism in non-fiction articles.

sessions.subject: Mathematics
sessions.tutorNotes: Mastered LCD methods with visual fraction bars. His confidence with unlike denominators has risen significantly compared to last month.
sessions.nextSteps: Progress into multiplying fraction word problems.
